headline: 7 more children die as measles-like symptoms claim 738 lives since March
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports 1,031 new cases of measles or measles-like symptoms in the last 24 hours.
details: Seven more children have died within 24 hours due to measles-like symptoms, according to the latest report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
Since March 15, a total of 738 deaths have been recorded nationwide, consisting of 645 deaths linked to measles-like symptoms and 93 confirmed measles deaths.
In the last 24 hours alone, 1,031 children were reported to be suffering from measles or measles-like symptoms.
Over the past three and a half months, 88,844 people with measles-like symptoms have been admitted to hospitals across the country.
Of those admitted, 85,122 patients have recovered and been discharged from medical facilities.
caption:
738 deaths since March. 1,031 new cases in just 24 hours. Bangladesh is facing a severe measles-like symptom crisis.

Seven more children have died within 24 hours due to measles-like symptoms, according to the latest report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

Since March 15, a total of 738 deaths have been recorded nationwide, consisting of 645 deaths linked to measles-like symptoms and 93 confirmed measles deaths.

In the last 24 hours alone, 1,031 children were reported to be suffering from measles or measles-like symptoms.

Over the past three and a half months, 88,844 people with measles-like symptoms have been admitted to hospitals across the country.

Of those admitted, 85,122 patients have recovered and been discharged from medical facilities.

headline: Video shows man attempting extortion by grabbing testicles of MD
summary: A viral video captures a shocking attempt to extort money from a Managing Director, using physical assaulty as a leverage.
details: A shocking video has gone viral on social media showing a man attempting to extort money from a Managing Director (MD).
In the footage, the assailant is seen physically assaulting the MD by grabbing his testicles to force him into paying money.
The incident occurred within an office setting, as captured by a security camera.
The viral clip has sparked widespread condemnation and calls for immediate legal action against the perpetrator.
